title: Hatching Triage Sandbox
description:
Hatching Triage is a malware analysis sandbox that automatically analyzes malicious files and URLs, extracting configuration data, network indicators, and behavioral information.

This connector submits Artifact files and URLs to Hatching Triage for dynamic analysis. File SCOs are enriched only when a matching existing analysis is found using a supported hash; their attached files are not used or submitted. OpenCTI is enriched with the analysis results including:

- Malware family identification
- C2 server addresses and URLs
- Network indicators (domains, IPs)
- Extracted credentials
- MITRE ATT&CK TTPs
- Dropped files and configurations
- Botnet and campaign information
short_description: Hatching Triage connector detonates Artifact files and URLs in a malware sandbox and enriches File SCOs from matching existing analyses.
